FROM television_shows
JOIN appearances ON television_shows.show_id = appearances.show_id
JOIN hosts ON television_shows.host_id = hosts.host_id
WHERE appearances.guest_name = 'Paul Melba' AND television_shows.country = 'United Kingdom'
GROUP BY host_name
HAVING number_of_shows = 23
